paragraphs.source_en: On New Year's Day in the twelfth year of Tenbun, as the people exchanged New Year’s greetings in the forecourt, they also celebrated the young lord’s birth. A thin layer of snow had fallen the day before, and throughout the castle people proclaimed it an auspicious snowfall.

units.source_en: On New Year's Day in the twelfth year of Tenbun, as the people exchanged New Year’s greetings in the forecourt, they also celebrated the young lord’s birth.
units.source_zh: 天文十二年大年初一，人们在前庭贺年的同时，也祝贺公子的诞生。

units.source_en: A thin layer of snow had fallen the day before, and throughout the castle people proclaimed it an auspicious snowfall.
units.source_zh: 昨日下了薄薄的一层雪，城里的人纷纷传扬此乃一场瑞雪。

paragraphs.source_zh: 天文十二年大年初一，人们在前庭贺年的同时，也祝贺公子的诞生。昨日下了薄薄的一层雪，城里的人纷纷传扬此乃一场瑞雪。

paragraphs.source_en: Though both were lying-in rooms, Odai’s chamber at Furodani was spacious and bright, filled with gentle sunlight. Aku’s lying-in room, however, had been moved to a maid’s chamber at the far end of the longhouse. The cold, gloomy room was heartbreaking. No one had visited for two days. Only her maid Oman remained at her side, blowing on the charcoal beneath the pot.

units.source_en: Though both were lying-in rooms, Odai’s chamber at Furodani was spacious and bright, filled with gentle sunlight.

paragraphs.source_en: “They say the young lord will inherit his grandfather’s childhood name, and that the lord of the castle has decided to name him Takechiyo on his seventh day.” Blowing on the charcoal beneath the pot, Oman added in her brisk way, “When young Lord Kanroku was born, the lord of the castle came especially to see him.”

paragraphs.source_en: Lady Aku said nothing. She merely gazed at the deathly white paper window and now and then let out a faint sigh.

paragraphs.source_en: Beside Lady Aku lay a sleeping infant. He and Takechiyo, born to the principal wife, had come into the world in the same year, the same month, on the same day, and at the very same hour—a circumstance Lady Aku found both uncanny and unbearably sad. Could a struggle between women truly go this far?

paragraphs.source_en: Amid the midwife’s hoarse cries, Aku heard the night watchman making his rounds about the castle; then she lost consciousness. Yet somewhere beneath consciousness, she was enveloped by the joy of victory. But when she learned that the principal wife had at that very moment also delivered a jewel-like boy, her joy vanished in misery.

paragraphs.source_zh: 在接生婆声嘶力竭喊叫的同时，阿久听到了绕城的更夫打更之声，然后便失去了知觉。但在潜意识中，一种胜利的喜悦笼罩着她。然而，当她听说上房夫人也在同时生下一个玉一般的男儿时，她的喜悦悲惨地消失了。

paragraphs.source_en: Both children were boys, but one had been born to a concubine and the other to the lawful wife. Moreover, one had been named Takechiyo, a name of great significance to the Matsudaira house, while the other remained nameless even after his seventh day had passed. Lady Aku felt bitterly wronged. Why could Odai not have borne a girl? Why could their births not have been separated by even a single hour?

units.source_en: Both children were boys, but one had been born to a concubine and the other to the lawful wife.

paragraphs.source_en: At noon on the twenty-sixth, Lady Aku heard of the miracle at Hōraiji Temple.

units.source_en: At noon on the twenty-sixth, Lady Aku heard of the miracle at Hōraiji Temple.

paragraphs.source_en: She had thought that once Hirotada heard she was unwell after giving birth, even if he did not come himself, he would at least send someone to see her. paragraphs.source_en: Aku felt that she needed to reconsider everything.
